issues.fix: Require read inputs when args.case == "all" as well as "read", or change the default to an explicit delete-only mode and make all require both read and delete. Add a guard test that run/compute_status cannot return DATA_RECORDED for --case all without read_rounds.
issues.issue: Default --case all can report DATA_RECORDED without running the 64MiB read diagnostic when read inputs are omitted. run() only rejects missing read inputs for --case read at line 433, while compute_status() line 347 includes read_status for --case all only if read_rounds is non-empty. Because --case delete already exists for delete-only collection, this creates a false-PASS path for an all-case run that records only delete data while result metadata still advertises read_shape.
issues.why_it_matters: The frozen contract requires one warmup plus five paired read samples and separate delete pairs for this diagnostic. A parent invoking the default case could publish an all-slice DATA_RECORDED result without read evidence.
